decision.summary: Configuration Packages and Configuration Worksheet remain the realistic implementation route candidates for repeated Universaarl Foundation setup data, but only after a read-first table-field proof for Table 323, Table 325 and Table 252. No package write, Get Tables action, field selection, import, export, validate or apply is allowed by this decision.

sourceBasis.source: Microsoft Learn - Import business data from other finance systems
sourceBasis.usedFor: Configuration Packages are appropriate for larger implementation work, empty companies, setup data and imported master data templates.

sourceBasis.source: Microsoft Learn - Set up company configuration packages
sourceBasis.usedFor: Reusable setup packages, Configuration Worksheet and setup tables such as General Posting Setup and VAT Posting Setup.

sourceBasis.source: Microsoft Learn - Apply Company Configuration Packages
